LiquidGlass.dc.html.title: Liquid Glass · every glass surface, Clear / Tinted, states, RT / IC

s0.text:
Look and rules: DESIGN.md (repo root) wins over these boards. One Action Blue, glass only on chrome unless Glass everywhere is on, AA measured, tokens in static/css/tokens.css.

Page and phone boards are generated from the app at 4540c51: real templates, static/css verbatim, Wakaba look with glass chrome. Sample data is made up.

UX = Notion patterns: sidebar by journey (daily · Track · Grow, Settings at the bottom), breadcrumbs, every epic / meeting / topic / note is a page, lines behave like blocks (click to edit, × or ⋯ to delete, Undo toast), capture bar floats at the bottom.
Reduce Transparency / Increase Contrast → glass turns opaque.

s1.text:
Empty states (each names the next action; exact copy on the States board)
· Today: “Nothing logged yet.” + example lines
· Pinned plans: “No plans pinned. Pin an open plan to see it here.”
· To-dos: “No open plans. Log a line starting with >.”
· Report: “Nothing logged in this range. Try This month”
· Meetings: “No meetings yet.”
· Learn: “No topics yet. Log a line like ? vector-search: …”
· Notes: “No notes yet.” + New note

s2.text:
UX decisions live in the spec → “UX decisions (2026-11-11)”.
Stack: Rust (axum + askama + rusqlite) · htmx for no-reload actions + field autosave; every action also works as a plain form POST.
Live hint under the line box: the same parser on keyup → “will save as impact on OPS-101”.

s4.text:
LLM layer has no screen.
Agents write through the atharu CLI as themselves (log · epic · note · evidence --as claude); Claude Code’s /log and /ingest (plus /query, /lint) wrap it. In the app: an agent badge on lines it filed, and its notes under “Written by LLM” on Notes.

s5.text:
Calendar
· Week: desktop grid, phone agenda. Month: 7 columns, phone = day numbers with a dot.
· Shows to-do due dates, epic targets, meetings, lines logged per day and your own events.
· Google read-only through the calendar’s secret iCal address (ical_url in data/config.toml, never in git); a failed refresh says “Couldn’t reach Google Calendar. Showing the last copy.”

s6.text:
Breakpoints (same templates, CSS only)
· ≥1024 px: desktop as drawn above.
· 640–1023 px: sidebar shrinks to a 64 px icon rail (labels as tooltips); content sheet keeps its max-width.
· <640 px (these boards): glass top bar with ☰ → pages drawer; title + day nav in the bar; capture bar pinned to the bottom (safe-area aware), grammar legend behind the ? button.

Touch rules
· every target ≥44 px; hover-only controls (× delete, Pin/Drop) become a visible ⋯ menu per line.
· inputs 16 px so iOS doesn't zoom.
· props stack label-over-value; tables become stacked rows or scroll in their own box; calendar week → agenda list, month → 7-column dots.
· Reduce Transparency → glass turns opaque.

The phone boards are the same generated pages with the <640 rules pinned on.

s7.text:
Settings pattern
· Apple System Settings: grouped inset list (rounded group, hairline dividers inset from the left), one control per row on the right: switch for on/off, segmented control for Clear | Tinted, slider with end icons.
· Notion settings: bold label + one-line help on the left, sections with small grey headers.
· Look = 4 app-icon tiles, the picked one ringed in accent (like macOS Appearance).
· Opacity slider shows the real 0–100 scale; the part below the look's readable floor is hatched and unreachable, so 60% sits at 60%.
· Live preview tile shows sidebar glass (and the page when Glass everywhere is on).
· Connections are status only (set in data/config.toml).

s8.text:
Control rules (go into DESIGN.md §6)
· One height per context: 32 px in chrome (top bar), 36 px in the page, 44 px on phone. Labels centred with flex + line-height 1.
· Single-line fields are glass pills (44 px; capture bar 52 px) with their action inside on the right, focus = blue ring.
· Secondary buttons = glass pill (a step more opaque than what they sit on); primary = the one blue pill.
· Day nav = one glass capsule: Today | ‹ | date ▾ | ›; the date opens the native picker.
· Legend chips sit on one baseline and wrap as whole items.
· Reduce Transparency → the same shapes, solid white.

s9.text:
Component library (for T28)
· Every control in the app, every state that can happen: default · hover · focus-visible · pressed · selected · disabled · error (422, input kept) · loading (htmx-request) · empty.
· Drawn over Wakaba with Glass everywhere on; each board ends with a plain Sumi strip (solid sheet) and Reduce Transparency / Increase Contrast variants.
· Hover/focus/pressed are forced with classes here; in the app they are :hover, :focus-visible, :active, [disabled], .htmx-request.
· .util (28, square) becomes the 32 glass pill; .btn.ghost becomes the glass secondary.
· Copy is from the templates; two menu empty lines are marked 'proposed copy'.
· Colours outside DESIGN.md §1 that the CSS already uses: #e8f1fb, #272729, #2997ff, #4d8fd1, #fafafc, #f5f9fe, #b0b0b5, heat #e3effc/#bcd6f2/#003d7a.
